title: Breaking the Chains of Magical Thinking in Our Community

top_liked.author: @bazingaburg8264
top_liked.text: My main beef with magical thinking is selling people on the notion that inaction changes anything. We've all heard "two hands working can do more than thousand clasped in prayer" and i've yet to hear anybody make a dent in that.

top_liked.author: @scottdavis3571
top_liked.text: Religions have broken our families. Religions didn't give us love. We already had love.

top_liked.author: @SeanDeconstructed
top_liked.text: Bury superstition and this story book of magic and spells💯
